title: Crystal per Second HUD
description: Mod that displays End Crystals destroyed per second (CPS) as an in-game HUD overlay, with full multi-version support via Stonecutter.
body: # Crystal per Second HUD [](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java21) [](https://modrinth.com/mod/crystal-per-second-hud) A modern Fabric mod that displays End Crystals destroyed per second (CPS) as an in-game HUD overlay, with full multi-version support via Stonecutter. > **Editor Keybind: `H`** ## Use Cases - **Crystal PvP Practice**: Track your real-time crystal destruction speed while training - **Performance Benchmarking**: Compare CPS output across different crystal optimizer mods ## Features ### CPS Tracker Tracks End Crystal destructions in real-time and displays them directly on your screen: - **Instant Mode**: Reactive calculation, averaged over the last 3 intervals - **Smoothed Mode**: Window-based calculation, counted over a rolling 1-second window - **Live Updates**: HUD value updates continuously as you play, no manual refresh needed ### Editable HUD Full in-game control over how the HUD looks and where it sits: - **Drag & Resize**: Reposition and resize the HUD directly in the editor screen - **Editor Popup**: Quick-access gear icon (⚛) for toggling display options ### Display Customization Fine-tune the HUD to fit your setup: - **Background**: Toggle the dark background box - **Borders**: Toggle the white border around the HUD - **Text Shadow**: Toggle text shadow rendering - **"CPS" Label**: Show or hide the "CPS" label suffix - **Green When Active**: Color the text green whenever CPS > 0 - **Smooth CPS**: Switch between instant and window-based calculation ### Crystal Optimizer Compatibility Counts crystal destructions via `Player.attack()`, so it works correctly alongside most crystal optimizer mods: - Marlow's Crystal Optimizer - Walksy Crystal Optimizer - CrystalAccelerator - G1ax Tweak Mode **Known limitation**: G1ax Crystal Optimizer (Default Mode) bypasses vanilla attack paths and may result in lower CPS readings. ## Installation ### Requirements - Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.11 or 26.1 - Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ - FabricAPI ### Download Download the mod from Modrinth and place the `.jar` file into your `.minecraft/mods` folder. [**Download on Modrinth**](https://modrinth.com/mod/crystal-per-second-hud) ## License CC0 1.0 Universal — feel free to use, modify, and distribute. ## Credits - Fabric API Team - Minecraft Modding Community
